note: A well-formed reversal plan on a destructive migration. The plan is real but cannot undo a dropped table, and Type 1 needs an ADR.
title: Drop legacy users.email and legacy_invoices
body:
Cleanup.

Reversal Trigger: search error rate > 2% for 5 minutes, watched by the search on-call.
Rollback Path: set flag NEW_SEARCH=off in the config service (takes effect in under a minute), or revert this PR.
Owner: search on-call
